Name: FS - Outfit Series - Beachwear
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43581/43581-1773346807-713240224.png[/img][size=3]﻿
Beachwear is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] pack which adds various vanilla-inspired beachwear via the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Hand-Mirror-Tool]Hand Mirror[/url] tool.

The pack includes:
- Over 9 swimsuit outfits
- Dynamic swimming goggles and sunglasses, which cover the eyes when swimming or outdoors
- Sandals and two different shoeless options
- Various beach-related accessories, like a floating tube!
[/size]
